messages:
zoe_csm: Quick flag — OrionPay (mid-market, went live 10 weeks ago) shows steep falloff in report exports and finance team says critical P&L columns missing. Renewal in 27 days. This feels like a product + enablement gap; want to kick off a tight save play.

ben_ae: Noted. If we don't recover theyll likely request a downgrade or discount. What's the immediate plan?

zoe_csm: Quick play: 48h triage + 7d enablement + 14d recovery runway + renewal decision at day 21. Owners: me (CS lead), Mika (enablement), Kai (support), Rohan (product), Ben (AE).

kai_support: Logged ticket 91267. Customer attached two CSVs showing missing columns. I can try repro in staging and add a temp transform script.

mika_onboard: I can run a 30-min "finance export" workshop aimed at their accountants — will demo workaround and map missing fields. Will record.

pm_rohan: Product note: there's an existing backlog item for export schema extensibility but no short ETA. We should request a hotfix or a targeted patch if repro is simple.

zoe_csm: Minimal triage checklist (to finish in 48h):
```
- Triage call: CS + Support + PM + Eng oncall + customer finance lead
- Customer: upload 3 sample exports + scheduled job IDs
- Support: reproduce missing columns in staging + attach repro to ticket 91267
- Provide short-term transform script and mapping doc to customer
- Enable in-app banner for their org linking to office-hours
- Run 30-min enablement within 7 days (recorded)
- Monitor weekly export success rate + small NPS pulse for 2 weeks
- If recovery < 80% after 14 days -> recommend AE offer (downgrade path or credit)
```

ben_ae: For AE options, propose: (A) 1-month credit, (B) downgrade to Lite for next billing cycle with migration help, (C) extended onboarding SOW hours. We'll decide after 14-day checkpoint.

kai_support: I've added repro attempt note and a quick Python snippet in ticket: `python transform_exports.py --fix-columns`. Pushed high priority label.

ops_bot: Ticket 91267 created; SLA: triage in 48h.

mika_onboard: Invite created: OrionPay - Export Workshop (in 30 hrs). Internal 15-min sync after for AE decisioning.

zoe_csm: Success metrics for 21-day renewal checkpoint:
- Export job success >= 85% OR documented adoption/recovery plan with dates
- No open reporting bugs OR customer accepted mitigation
- Post-workshop NPS >= 7 OR AE signs off on account health

pm_rohan: We'll prioritize a small patch if repro is straightforward. Otherwise provide clear roadmap note to customer + timeline. Transparency helps retention.

ben_ae: I'll draft an exec-facing recovery one-pager (metrics + timeline + AE offer) to hand to customer if needed.

zoe_csm: Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend triage.

kai_support: :thumbsup:

mika_onboard: :thumbsup:

zoe_csm: Follow-up: I've posted banner copy for review: "Trouble with exports? Join our quick workshop to restore P&L exports and get a temporary transform script. Book a slot: [link]" ETA to push: 18h.

ben_ae: :thumbsup: Keep me posted after the workshop so I can prepare the AE offer options.
